note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate and the worker are both recorded as unknown in the original, so only a soldier section is provided; synonymy lists, figure numbers, locality and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule golden yellow, mandibles reddish at the base and on the sides; mandibles nearly black; body milk-white; head and body densely setose. Total length 7.8. Head capsule subrectangular, sides weakly convex, width about two-thirds of the length to the mandibular base (length with mandibles 3.8, length to mandibular base 2.18, maximum width 1.40, ratio of width to length 0.64); coronal suture not reaching half the head length. Fontanelle small and transverse, at about three-quarters of the head length from the posterior margin of the head; frontal gland large and conspicuous. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus not distinctly delimited from the frons, setose; anteclypeus hyaline, glabrous, subquadrate. Labrum asymmetrical, anterolateral angles produced into pointed processes, anterior margin incurved (length 0.33, width 0.30). Mandibles asymmetrical, slightly shorter than the head (left 2.10, right 2.03, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.96). Basal half of the left mandible weakly curved and incurved, with a conspicuous incurved beak apically, the part below the beak strongly arched, the inner margin nearly straight. Right mandible blade-like, pointed and weakly incurved apically. Postmentum short and clavate, waist near the posterior margin and weakly incurved (length 0.83, maximum width 0.43, waist width 0.35). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a concavity at the middle, posterior margin weakly incurved at the middle (length 0.43, width 0.83); mesonotum narrower than the pronotum, metanotum as wide as the pronotum, both with a concavity at the middle of the posterior margin. Tibial apical spurs 3:2:2, dorsal spur of the fore tibia weak; tarsus 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate and setose, cerci short, 2-segmented.
